# Upstream Source

This directory is a full snapshot of
[fnlp-vision/MOSS-VL-Realtime_Demo](https://github.com/fnlp-vision/MOSS-VL-Realtime_Demo),
copied into this repository on 2026-09-21 at commit
`a927f3f3d588907972adaceafeeb3bb6ebee054e` (branch `main`). Only the `.git/`
metadata directory was removed; all remaining file contents are
byte-identical to the upstream snapshot. The snapshot bundles its own
vendored components (CosyVoice, MOSS-TTS-Nano, Matcha-TTS) under
`server/adapters/`, and each component retains its respective license.
